items.text: Las Vegas (final report): OUT: DE Patrick Johnson (stinger), TE Carter Runyon (foot). QUESTIONABLE: C/G Jackson Powers-Johnson (back/illness), WR Jack Bech (activated from IR). TE Brock Bowers, LB Quay Walker and T DJ Glaze practiced fully Friday and have no designation.

New York (final report): OUT: EDGE Joseph Ossai (ankle), OL Max Mitchell (concussion), DT T'Vondre Sweat (knee, placed on IR Saturday). DOUBTFUL: EDGE David Bailey (groin, no practice all week). QUESTIONABLE: RB Breece Hall (quad), OL Dylan Parham (knee).
